description: What a transaction costs right now: Solana priority fee levels (low to very high, micro-lamports per compute unit) and the USD cost of a typical transfer and swap, plus Base gas price, base fee and the USD cost of an ERC-20 transfer. Use it to set fees that land without overpaying. Price: 0.002 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"network_fees"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/crypto/fees

account.description: optional Solana program or account to estimate for (default: Jupiter router)
